Check.description: A control, and the names of the parts it applies to.

control.description:
The control to check the parts against, in the personal board's own
tree.

parts.description: Globs of the part names it applies to, such as pr.* or *.

description:
`boundary/boundary/v1`: the controls content must pass to leave a
checkout for a destination by an action.

Boundaries belong under `/boundaries/` in the personal board. Globs are
`SQLite` GLOB patterns: `*` matches any characters, `/` and `.` included.
Destinations match without case; action and part names match with case.

actions.description: Globs of the actions it applies to, such as github.*.

checks.description: The controls to check and the parts each applies to.

from.description:
The checkouts it applies to, by their paths, usually mounts; left out
for any checkout.

to.description: A glob of the destinations it applies to, such as github:octo/*.

title: BoundaryRecord
